data.name: Seal of Shadows
data.detailed_description:
Master the art of the blade, the bow, and the arcane in Seal of Shadows. Dive into a visceral 2D hack-and-slash ARPG designed for solo play or 3-player local co-op. Shatter nightmarish hordes, loot epic gear, and reclaim a broken world in a hand-crafted 20-hour campaign inspired by the golden age of arcade brawlers.

SEAMLESS 3-PLAYER LOCAL CO-OP / STEAM DROP-IN PLAY

  • Seamless Drop-In/Drop-Out: Don’t let a late arrival stop the fun. Friends can join or leave your session at any time without interrupting the flow of combat or forcing a restart.

  • Couch Co-Op Excellence: Built from the ground up for shared-screen mayhem. Combine class abilities to trigger Epic Synergies: have your Warrior pull enemies into a cluster while the Mage unleashes a blizzard and the Ranger executes stragglers.

  • Seamless Steam Invite: Right click a friend and invite them to join your game at any time.

CLASS-BASED MAYHEM

  • The Warrior: A frontline powerhouse. Master crushing combos, area-of-effect slams, and unbreakable defensive stances.

  • The Ranger: Precision from the shadows. Deploy deadly traps, fire piercing volleys, and use high-mobility dashes to kite the horde.

  • The Mage: Control the elements. Rain down meteor showers, summon arcane guardians, and buff your allies with ancient sorcery.

DEEP RPG PROGRESSION

  • 20+ Hour Campaign: Explore haunted forests, crumbling citadels, and the abyssal depths of Banesmeire.

  • Loot & Customize: Find and equip rare weapons and armor that change your playstyle and appearance.

  • Skill Trees: Tailor your hero with branching skill paths—build a tanky Warrior or a high-crit glass cannon.

data.short_description: Shatter the darkness in this 3-player co-op ARPG. Master 3 unique classes, loot epic gear, and battle through a 20+ hour hand-crafted campaign. Inspired by classics like Shadows of Mystara—grab a controller and forge your legend in Banesmeire today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Dual Core 1.8GHz (or higher) or AMD Athlon II X2 (or higher)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GF6600 (or higher) or ATi X1600 (or higher) with 256MB of RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible, DirectX 9.0c (or higher) compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Dual Core 2.4GHz (or higher) or AMD Athlon II X2 (or higher)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GF8000 (or higher) or ATi X1800 (or higher) with 256MB of RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible, DirectX 9.0c (or higher) compatible
